batch119 independent read-only review
Snapshot: Candidate 2211457052dd721178b9b70a2e0f9cbe8833908e; frozen EN 6af98cb717755690a9ca793e5454a96ebd7a8f9f; accepted RU 48eb008ac0d2180f7d17b709bc7e811fca32e64d. Opening and closing gates agreed: 2346 runtime objects, all 2340 baseline objects retained, three new raw-identical stroke files. Bound scope SHA256 82bb312f4e4b1303a090bf4f0644e7a89d49d659013dbd65bf95a945c40b9cac.
Scope: All 53 requested reading windows returned completely, exit 0, plus both gates. Read all four guidance documents and three current RU rubrics; 32 complete teaching bodies (17 EN, 15 RU): three primary pairs, eleven context pairs, linked 怖い pair, two EN-only comparisons; fifteen KANJIDIC2 records, radical evidence, provider header, 53 JMdict entries, three KanjiPedia captures; all 419 current typed kanji rows; nine proposals, three adjudications, three clarifications, three outside-limit observations. No failed/unread windows.
C1 NEEDS FIX: One incorrect relationship between the illness sense of 感 and its abbreviation sense (F001). Otherwise the three lessons preserve frozen Japanese metadata, spellings, selected readings, tags and community N3 classification; 10/11/13 strokes and 心/61 agree with official evidence. Attributed sound components 巩/靑/咸 are supported; modern mnemonics are clearly separated from history. 恐's awe/reverential-trepidation branch is defensible, not an invented ordinary meaning of every compound.
C2 UNVERIFIED for ordinary active-negative quiz deployment; CLEAN for the bounded dependency and introductory-comparison scope. All new relative links resolve within the read candidate lessons: 工/心/怖/忘/念; 青/性/忙/感; 心/忘/息/必/情/思; words/怖い. Missing RU word lessons remain plain text, not dangling links. Nine directions assessed separately below. Shared readings in N004/N005 prohibit a blanket reading-negative approval; no reverse or transitive approval is inferred.
C3 CLEAN within the three new lessons: Natural, comprehensible Russian without reliance on English; readings accompany the core taught vocabulary. 情 and 感 legitimately share «чувство» and are explained through different lexical examples, not falsely presented as disjoint meanings. F001 concerns Japanese semantic accuracy, not Russian fluency.
N001恐→工 S-intro: 工 «ремесло; строительство» contrasts with fear/awe; the 工-shaped portion inside upper 巩 is real. KANJIDIC2/JMdict 1346260, 2414410 support the foil's craft senses, not fear. Ordinary all-mode safety U.
N002恐→忘 S-intro: 忘 «забывать» is distinct from fear; shared lower 心 and different tops support the comparison. KANJIDIC2 and JMdict 1519210 agree. Ordinary all-mode safety U.
N003恐→念 S-intro: 念 «мысль; внимание» is not a translation of 恐; lower 心 provides the visual comparison. JMdict 1469320 also gives feeling/concern, but that does not make thought/attention a fear gloss. Ordinary all-mode safety U.
N004情→青 S-intro only; REJECT as a セイ reading negative: 青 «синий; зелёный» is not a meaning of 情, but 青 is its entire modern right part and both metadata lists contain セイ. Shape comparison is strong; unrestricted active-negative approval is not supported.
N005情→性 S-intro only; REJECT as a セイ reading negative: 性 «натура; пол» differs from the taught emotion/circumstances senses; both have 忄 and セイ. KanjiPedia's innate-heart explanation of 情 also counsels against claiming unrestricted semantic disjointness. Ordinary broader safety U.
N006情→忙 S-intro: 忙 «занятой» is not an established meaning of 情 in the supplied evidence; same left 忄, different right 青/亡. Busy/restless secondary senses do not equate to emotion/circumstances. Ordinary all-mode safety U.
N007感→忘 S-intro: 忘 «забывать» does not answer 感's feeling/sensing meanings; shared bottom 心 is explicit and accurate. No overlap established by the supplied secondary senses. Ordinary all-mode safety U.
N008感→必 S-intro: 必 «непременно; необходимость» is distinct from feeling/sensation; the lesson correctly calls this a more distant contour comparison, not a detachable common lower 心. JMdict 2799020 certainty adds no overlap. Ordinary all-mode safety U.
N009感→息 S-intro: 息 «дыхание» is not a gloss of 感; shared lower 心 and different upper groups support the contrast. 息's rest/son/interest/end senses do not establish an overlap with 感. Ordinary all-mode safety U.
L001恐 SUPPORTED within introductory scope: Metadata and core vocabulary agree with evidence; respectful trepidation supports the title's awe branch. Mnemonic and dictionary derivation are properly distinguished.
L002情 SUPPORTED within introductory scope: Feelings/circumstances, 情け compassion/affection, 心 as 忄 and phonetic 靑 are supported. セイ [高] is accurately qualified.
L003感 PARTIALLY SUPPORTED: カン without kun readings, 感じる's on-reading plus ending, core vocabulary and phonetic 咸 are supported; the claimed abbreviation relationship in the illness explanation needs F001's correction.
A001 SUPPORTED: JMdict 1236690 explicitly qualifies the surprising/amazing sense as often 恐ろしく; 1593480/1496930 list 怖い/怖がる first and permit 恐 spellings. This is bounded dictionary usage, not an independent frequency measurement.
A002 SUPPORTED: JMdict 1314010 supports circumstances/reasons, 1356220 compassion/mercy and affection, 1150860 love/affection. The warning against imposing one 情 sense on every word is appropriate.
A003 SUPPORTED: JMdict 1212480 supports impressions/reactions, 1212260 feeling/sensing, 1212410 emotion/feelings; KanjiPedia also directly shows 感じる as カン－じる.
NAV: none (zero navigation changes) — confirmed by the gated unchanged baseline and complete new lesson reads; no word-file changes or navigation amendment.
Outside LIMIT dispositions: O001 retained as a limit: 怖 overlaps in fear and readings, 忙 shares おそ.れる, 強 shares キョウ/こわ.い, 心 is a component; these are not new guards. O002 retained as a limit: 情/感 share «чувство», 情/愛 overlap in affection; 事/思/心 are related domains, not automatically interchangeable full labels. O003 retained as a limit: 感/情 overlap directly; 想/思/心 require mode-specific judgment, while 成 is a partial shape contact only. Fallback safety remains U; no automatic exclusion clique.
Findings: F001 — moderate, C1, kanji/感.md, «Значение и происхождение», sentence beginning «кроме того»: «„заражаться, заболевать“ — сокращение от 感冒 (感染, 流感)» incorrectly makes the infection/illness meaning itself an abbreviation. Learners may infer that 感染 derives from shortening 感冒. KanjiPedia 0001095900 meaning ② separates 染まる。かかる from また、「感冒」の略: an additional abbreviation use, not the origin of the preceding sense. Fix by separating them: «Кроме того, 感 может передавать значение „заражаться, заболевать“ (感染); также служит сокращением от 感冒 — „простуда“ (например, в 流感)». Evidence: complete bound KanjiPedia entry; confidence high.
Optional: Prefer «страх; благоговейный трепет» for 恐 if a more tightly bounded Russian rendering of awe is desired; existing title is not a confirmed defect. Add a short note that 情 and 感 overlap rather than trying to make their valid titles artificially exclusive. Readings for the additional KanjiPedia illustration compounds would reduce beginner load.
Limits: No external web pages fetched; KanjiPedia was read only through the three complete bound captures named above. No app/runtime quiz implementation, fallback selection, pixels, device behavior, learning outcomes or modern usage frequencies independently tested. Thus introductory comparison support is not ordinary quiz guard approval; the consequences of shared セイ depend on actual question modes. No tests/builds/validators/git commands, file writes or delegation performed. Existing unlinked 恐 in 怖, unlinked 青白い in 青, and 強's こわ.い metadata remain outside this batch's changes. The signed intake's four-versus-three count erratum is acknowledged, not charged as a candidate defect.
